items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The drummer at that time, before you came was Charlie Horvath. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: This is February 12, 1980. I am talking with Chauncey Morehouse and Virginia Morehouse in their home in Leisuretown, New Jersey. Virginia, also for the record, Virginia Morehouse was the sister of Charlie Horvath.
